training.modulesHeading: 9 practical areas covered in the training

modules.title: 1. The Water Production Business
modules.text: Understand sachet and bottled water production, factory sizes, business models and the value chain.

modules.title: 2. Water Treatment & Quality
modules.text: Raw water analysis, filtration, reverse osmosis where needed, UV, sanitation, testing and monitoring.

modules.title: 3. Production Machines
modules.text: Sachet and bottle machines, filling, sealing, capping, equipment quality, original versus substandard machines and maintenance.

modules.title: 4. Factory Planning & Installation
modules.text: Site and building layout, treatment areas, hygiene, drainage, workflow, storage, equipment arrangement and installation.

modules.title: 5. NAFDAC & Compliance Planning
modules.text: Registration steps, facility preparation, inspections, documentation, product testing, labels and regulatory planning.

modules.title: 6. Risks & Factory Failures
modules.text: Breakdowns, water quality, staffing, power, distribution, compliance issues and how to reduce avoidable losses.

modules.title: 7. Capital & Startup Planning
modules.text: Understand setup cost categories, business sizes, production capacity and starting small versus scaling up.

modules.title: 8. Profitability & Management
modules.text: Evaluate pricing, costs, distribution, production volume, cash flow, maintenance and reinvestment.

modules.title: 9. Opportunities Beyond Factory Ownership
modules.text: Understand equipment sourcing, customer referrals, installation career paths, distribution and building toward ownership.

faqs.question: Do I need to own a water factory to register?
faqs.answer: No. You can learn before investing or explore industry roles that do not require factory ownership.

faqs.question: Will I understand NAFDAC requirements?
faqs.answer: The training covers a registration preparation plan and important compliance considerations. Confirm current requirements directly with NAFDAC.

faqs.question: Does the training guarantee income or a profitable factory?
faqs.answer: No. Financial outcomes depend on capital, execution, market conditions, quality control and compliance.

faqs.question: How do I get dates, fees and registration details?
faqs.answer: Use the registration button to contact Harrison and confirm the current training schedule, format, fees and enrolment requirements.

training.finalHeading: Learn first. Plan properly. Build with confidence.
training.finalText: Whether you are starting, upgrading or exploring an industry opportunity, make your next move with better information.
training.disclaimer: Training is educational and does not guarantee business profits, employment, regulatory approval or income.

seo.title: Harrison Water Solution & Machinery Services
seo.description: Water treatment, water factory machinery and related technical services.

products.name: Bottled Water Production Line
products.summary: A coordinated line for rinsing, filling, capping and handling bottled water production.
products.description: Bottled-water production lines can include bottle rinsing, filling, capping, labeling, coding, shrink wrapping and related material-handling equipment. Final configuration should match output targets, bottle sizes and available utilities.
products.seoDescription: Bottled-water production machinery and project-specific equipment planning.

products.name: Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment System
products.summary: RO treatment systems for applications where feed-water quality requires dissolved-solids reduction and finer purification.
products.description: Reverse osmosis is one stage within a complete water-treatment design. A suitable system depends on raw-water analysis, pretreatment needs, target output, recovery and final product-water requirements.
products.seoDescription: RO water-treatment systems for water-production and commercial applications.

specifications.label: Configuration
specifications.value: Designed from water analysis and required output

products.name: Automatic Sachet Water Machine
products.summary: Automatic forming, filling and sealing equipment for packaged sachet-water production.
products.description: A sachet-water machine forms packaging film, fills treated water and seals individual sachets. Machine selection should consider intended output, film compatibility, electrical requirements, support and availability of replacement parts.
products.seoDescription: Sachet-water production machinery and equipment guidance from Harrison Water Solution.

specifications.label: Capacity
specifications.value: Varies by machine model and configuration

services.name: Complete Water Factory Setup Support
services.summary: Practical guidance for organizing treatment, production equipment and workflow for a new or upgraded water factory.
services.description: Factory setup requires more than purchasing machines. The treatment system, equipment layout, hygiene flow, utilities, operating capacity and production goals need to work together. Harrison Water Solution can present verified setup support and project scope here.
services.seoDescription: Water factory setup guidance for sachet and bottled-water production projects.

services.name: Water Treatment System Planning & Installation
services.summary: Treatment-system planning based on source-water condition, intended application and required production capacity.
services.description: A dependable water-production operation starts with understanding the raw-water condition and selecting the correct treatment stages. Systems may involve multimedia filtration, softening, activated carbon, reverse osmosis, UV and ozone depending on actual treatment requirements.
services.seoDescription: Water treatment planning, system configuration and installation support.

projects.summary: Planning, treatment-system installation, production machinery support and factory upgrades based on site conditions, production goals and required capacity.
